audit_scope: Read-only handoff-readiness audit of the five Component 2 models accepted by c2_pp1_freeze_v1
component_2_mutation_policy: Component 2 files were inspected but not modified
overall_finding: The repository documents five technically accepted fold-0 model configurations, but this checkout lacks all five checkpoint binaries and the fold-0 feature cache. No model has a C3-reproducible reference-score fixture, so none can yet be marked integrated.

source_evidence.role: frozen release contract and accepted model list
historical artifact inventory from the Component 2 freeze environment
common fold-0 evaluation and score semantics

shared_preprocessing_contract.input: uppercase peptide using only the 20 standard amino acids
shared_preprocessing_contract.feature_order: 480 ESM-2 dimensions followed by 15 descriptors in descriptors_v1 order

esm2.pooling: mean over residue representations only; BOS, EOS, and PAD excluded

shared_preprocessing_contract.scaling: apply fold-0 mean and standard deviation from fr3_fusion_scalers.json; do not refit
shared_preprocessing_contract.score_orientation: higher means stronger support for the positive/AOP class
shared_preprocessing_contract.calibration_warning: Scores are not calibrated biological probabilities
